example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নিজেকে তিমিঙ্গিল ভাবে, কিন্তু তিমিঙ্গিলগিলও আছে।
জীবনে কখনো অহংকার করো না, তিমিঙ্গিলেরও গিলতে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: He thinks he's a whale-swallowing beast, but there's always a bigger one.
Don't get arrogant in life; even the mightiest can be swallowed.
history: This idiom draws from a fictional chain of predators: a timi (whale) is swallowed by a timingil, which is swallowed by a timingil-gil, illustrating endless hierarchy in Bengali folklore expressions.
note: The idiom emphasizes humility through an imaginative, escalating food chain.
